definition_used: Dispute concerning permissions or ownership of materials (equipment, cell lines, etc.), technologies, images, text, patents, etc.
caution: Copyright claims can involve ownership disputes that may not directly affect research content reliability; classification is broad because the definition covers a range of materials and permissions, and the impact on manuscript integrity depends on context.
semantic_rationale: Copyright claims involve disputes over permissions or ownership of materials, text, images, or data, which directly relates to attribution and disclosure integrity. They also trigger legal processes and post-publication oversight, as journals may need to address rights issues after publication.
